import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
sub = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
before = sub[sub.date<'2025-09-22']
after = sub[sub.date>='2025-09-22']
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    b = before.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()/before.date.nunique()
    a = after.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()/after.date.nunique()
    cmp = pd.concat([b,a],axis=1,keys=['before','after']).fillna(0)
    cmp['delta']=cmp.after-cmp.before
    print(col); print(cmp.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(10)); print()

import pandas as pd
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
sub = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
base = sub[(sub.date>=pd.Timestamp('2025-09-01'))&(sub.date<=pd.Timestamp('2025-09-21'))]
mean = base.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].mean()
cnt = base.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].count()
print(mean.describe(), cnt.describe())
anom = sub[sub.date==pd.Timestamp('2025-09-22')]
m = anom.set_index(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost']
common = m.index.intersection(mean.index)
z = (m.loc[common]-mean.loc[common])/mean.loc[common].std()
# better: per-key std over baseline
std = base.groupby(['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family'])['unblended_cost'].std().fillna(0)
zs = (m.loc[common]-mean.loc[common])/(std.loc[common]+1e-9)
print(zs.sort_values(ascending=False).head(15))
new_keys = m.index.difference(mean.index)
print(anom.loc[new_keys])

df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])
sub = df[df.account_id=='tVENWJP'].copy()
before = sub[sub.date<'2025-09-22']
after = sub[sub.date>='2025-09-22']
for col in ['csp','cloud_service','application','instance_family']:
    b = before.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()/before.date.nunique()
    a = after.groupby(col)['unblended_cost'].sum()/after.date.nunique()
    cmp = pd.concat([b,a],axis=1,keys=['before','after']).fillna(0)
    cmp['delta']=cmp.after-cmp.before
    print(col); print(cmp.sort_values('delta',ascending=False).head(10)); print()"}
